display.purpose: The review title uses the same monospaced voice as the launcher data.

label.purpose: Status, key hints, and metadata stay compact and monospaced.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The surface stays calm and avoids decorative motion.

components.name: Void Launcher Input
components.description: A transparent query row with a leading terminal prompt and a quiet result count.
components.css: .ds-void-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; background: #050505; color: #F0F0EA; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240,240,234,.48); font: 15px/1.4 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-void-input input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #F0F0EA; caret-color: #F0F0EA; font: inherit; } .ds-void-input input::placeholder { color: #777A75; opacity: 1; } .ds-void-input:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #5660FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Void Application Row
components.description: A square-marked application choice with a two-line label and keyboard hint.
components.css: .ds-void-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240,240,234,.12); background: transparent; color: #949993; text-align: left; font: 14px/1.4 SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-void-row:hover { background: rgba(240,240,234,.06); color: #F0F0EA; } .ds-void-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5660FF; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-void-row[aria-selected="true"] { background: #F0F0EA; color: #050505; } .ds-void-row strong,.ds-void-row small { display: block; } .ds-void-row small { margin-top: 3px; color: #777A75; font-size: 10px; } .ds-void-row[aria-selected="true"] small { color: #050505; } .ds-void-mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-void-row kbd { margin-left: auto; color: inherit; font: 10px/1.4 inherit; }

narrative.overview:
Void is a single black surface held inside a pale measurement stage. The launcher does not decorate the task; it creates a temporary field of attention over the desktop and removes itself when the decision is made. Its visual language comes from terminal output, system overlays, and the quiet precision of a monochrome monitor.

The hierarchy is deliberately narrow: the query is the entry point, the application selection is the only high-contrast state, and system metadata stays subordinate.
keyCharacteristics: Flat near-black panel with a clear light border.
Monospace typography for query, data, status, and application rows.
Inverted selection row as the single strong state change.
Keyboard-first hints kept visible at the bottom edge.

rules.name: The One Contrast Rule
rules.body: The selected application row is the only area allowed to invert from black to light across the launcher list.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not use a decorative display face inside the launcher. A value that describes system state should look like data.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: If the panel needs more emphasis, increase contrast or clarify the border before adding elevation.

dos: Do preserve the exact 600 x 380px panel proportion for this surface.
Do use monochrome contrast to communicate selection and hierarchy.
Do keep the query focused on open and expose Up, Down, Enter, and Esc behavior.
donts: Don't add accent colors to application rows or categories.
Don't replace the selection inversion with a glow, gradient, or colored pill.
Don't introduce rounded cards, glass blur, or hard offset shadows into the Void panel.
